jobs.title: Wildcard
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About AIUC

AIUC builds standards and insurance for frontier AI. Our mission is to Underwrite superintelligence. We exist because risk, not capability, is becoming the binding constraint on AI being useful. History offers lessons for how to build confidence in new technology; electricity burned down houses until insurers funded Underwriters Laboratories (UL) to certify products against their standards. Today, the UL mark is a trustmark on every light bulb in America. We’re building that for AI.

AIUC-1, our standard for agent security, serves frontier builders like Cursor, Lovable, ElevenLabs, and Harvey. We've raised $55m from Ribbit, First Harmonic and Nat Friedman to audit frontier AI. Our team comes from METR, Anthropic, McKinsey, and OpenAI. Come join us.

Not sure you fit into a neat box like “engineer” or “designer,” but you think you’d crush it here? This wildcard application is for you. The best applications include a cover letter pitching why you'd be a good fit

Our Values

We are in the business of building trust. We take our values seriously and treat them as commitments to each other, held to the same bar as the ones we make to customers.

  • Strong back: high standards, keep our promises, work hard.

  • Fast feet: experiment, cut scope, take delight in pace.

  • Eyes up: wrestle with the mission, and let where AI is heading shape our strategy, our teams and our day-to-day work.

  • Open heart: say the scary thing, create connection, make room for emotions.

Underwriting superintelligence is our life's work. If you want it to be yours, apply now.

  • Competitive annual salary

  • Equity (significant part of total compensation)

  • Health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation stipend to bring you to SF, if needed

  • Daily lunch, dinner & snacks

The Role

Enterprises are under extreme pressure to adopt AI but they all face a security challenge - CISOs understandably worry about "how do I know this AI agent is secure, safe, and reliable?".

We see this in our work daily: we now have 250+ security & risk leaders in the AIUC-1 consortium excited to shape the standard that they and others can use to answer this question.

Many of these enterprises are pursuing AIUC-1 certification themselves – either for their internally built AI agents, or for agents built by vendors deployed in their environment.

We’re hiring a founding enterprise lead to help us build and deepen these enterprise partnerships & drive adoption of AIUC-1. This is a novel opportunity, and in practice you will:

  • Lead discovery with enterprises — understanding how each enterprise assesses AI vendor risk

  • Work closely with our founders to shape and run experiments for the GTM approach and AIUC-1 that meets the needs of enterprise CISOs

  • Own and grow our portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts — from first conversation through to signed partnership

  • Explore deepening in specific verticals eg Financial Services, building on the core AIUC-1 to meet the regulatory and business needs of these enterprises

What we're looking for

You’ll work with CISOs, General Counsels, and Chief AI Officers at Fortune 500 companies. They are senior leaders under enormous pressure to get AI adoption right. You need to be able to hold peer-like conversations with them to shape how they view this problem.

You will spend as much time thinking as you will in front of executives — building hypotheses, structuring the product, tailoring the messaging. The person who thrives here has done exactly this kind of work before, just with a different brief.

To be successful, we think you have:

  • 7-10 years of experience, likely at top consulting firm where you have led clients through complex, novel engagements

  • Comfort with long, ambiguous cycles requiring deep discovery, multithreading and resilience

The Role

AIUC certifies AI agents based on security, safety, and reliability. As our founding security lead, you will own security at a business that is built upon trust. Our stakeholders are CISOs at Fortune 500 enterprises and the world's fastest-growing AI companies. They trust us to tell them whether their systems can be trusted and that requires internal credibility, controls, and posture.

AIUC-1 as a standard is paving the way for agentic security, your expertise will directly influence what this means across the industry. Our security function will be what other companies will turn to as the playbook.

This is once in a life-time opportunity, and in practice you will:

  • Shape and evolve AIUC-1's security requirements as the agentic threat landscape changes, from prompt injection, adversarial attacks, jailbreaks, MCP and A2A risks

  • Be AIUC's external security voice on what AI agent security means in practice, through client conversations, consortium sessions, and thought leadership

  • Build and manage our core security infrastructure and build a world-class security posture, develop and enforce security policies and incident response across the organization

  • Be the practitioner's lens to how enterprises assess AI vendor security today

  • Handle enterprise client security and collaborate with our commercial team

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who has spent years in security and is now ready to use that expertise to shape a standard. You are as comfortable in a room with a CISO as you are in the technical details, and you would rather write the playbook than implement someone else's.

You'll need to have:

  • Deep experience in security, at a SaaS / AI / PS known for its rigour, with ownership spanning both strategic, technical and operational work

  • Deep familiarity with how enterprises evaluate AI vendor security

  • Technical fluency across the core stack

  • Expertise and strong communication skills within complex security topics

In this role, you will:

  • Own the path from signed customer to delivered results - scoping what to test, working through their authentication and interfaces, and getting their agent running in our system

  • Build the one-off version when a customer doesn't fit the product yet, and make it work anyway

  • Deliver results directly to the customer and be the person they trust with the technical detail

  • Make the call on whether a customer meets the AIUC-1 standard

  • Work across the widest surface of any role here: our Delivery team, our core engineers, sales, the Standards team (shaping what goes into AIUC-1), and your customer's own engineering team

  • Turn what you learn in the field into the product

That's why we're founding AIUC Labs – a research lab which will exist so that AIUC and the world at large is on the frontier in navigating AGI. You will work directly with the founders to build out a new function and publish research that will guide the industry on what’s next.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the questions that decide the strategic direction of AIUC: where AI capability & risk goes over the next 3-5 years, what replaces evals as agents get more capable, whether models behave differently when they know they are being tested, and how AI shifts the offense–defense balance in security

  • Take confidence infrastructure upstream to the model layer, where independent standards, rigorous evaluation and third-party assurance have to meet the release decisions labs are making now

  • Turn what AIUC has actually done into evidence, publish research and shape our public research programme, including the podcast and writing, that increases our influence in the space

  • You’re a strong engineer, and can design and independently build, debug, and maintain research code and experiment pipelines.

  • You can read an ML paper and implement it quickly, and extend or adapt it to a new research question.

  • You can iterate and experiment quickly, such as working through an ambiguous open-ended question and turning into a tractable experiment, choosing baselines, and investigating unexpected details, as well as deciding what comes next.

 - Own full-cycle recruiting for engineering and research roles, from intake and calibration through sourcing, screening, offer, and close

 - Partner with hiring managers to turn vague briefs into clear profiles and target lists

 - Build talent maps and sourcing plays for hard-to-find profiles in AI evals, security, and forward deployed engineering

 - Screen for what you can judge, and hand our technical interviewers candidates worth their time

 - Run offer conversations, including equity, for candidates with strong options elsewhere

 - Own the agency relationships for your searches

 - Track your funnel and tell us what's working and what isn't

 - Help make AIUC a place engineers want to work, through events and our team's networks


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5-7 years of full-cycle technical recruiting in high-growth tech, ideally at an early-stage AI or infrastructure company. (Impact matters more than years.)

 - You can explain what separates a great engineer from a good one, and engineering leaders trust your read

 - Concrete, creative sourcing for passive candidates

 - You've closed candidates with competing offers from top AI companies

 - You use data to run your searches, and you're comfortable pushing back when it tells you something the team doesn't want to hear


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience recruiting ML, research, or security engineers

 - An engineering or technical background

 - You've used AI or automation tools to make sourcing and screening faster




OUR VALUES

We are in the business of building trust. We take our values seriously and treat them as commitments to each other, held to the same bar as the ones we make to customers.

 - Strong back: high standards, keep our promises, work hard.

 - Fast feet: experiment, cut scope, take delight in pace.

 - Eyes up: wrestle with the mission, and let where AI is heading shape our strategy, our teams and our day-to-day work.

 - Open heart: say the scary thing, create connection, make room for emotions.

Underwriting superintelligence is our life's work. If you want it to be yours, apply now.




COMPENSATION & PERKS

 - Competitive annual salary

 - Equity (significant part of total compensation)

 - Health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation stipend to bring you to SF, if needed

 - Daily lunch, dinner & snacks
